title: Singapore Wins World's Best Airline Award for 2026
paragraphs: Singapore Airlines has been named the best airline in the world for 2026.

The award was given at the World Airline Awards, which are organized by Skytrax, a British company that researches airlines and airports. The results were announced at a ceremony in London on September 18, 2026. According to Skytrax, the awards are based on a customer satisfaction survey of passengers from more than 100 countries. The survey was carried out between September 2025 and August 2026, and it included more than 300 airlines.

This is the sixth time that Singapore Airlines has won the top award. It also won in 2004, 2007, 2008, 2018 and 2023. This year, it took the award back from Qatar Airways, which was the winner last year and came second this year. Cathay Pacific, from Hong Kong, was third. ANA All Nippon Airways, from Japan, was fourth, and Turkish Airlines was fifth.

Singapore Airlines also won several other awards. It was named the best airline in Asia, and it also won awards for the world's best economy class and the best food in economy class. In addition, Scoot, its low-cost airline, was named the best long-haul low-cost airline for the sixth year in a row.

Edward Plaisted, the head of Skytrax, said that this was the sixth time in the history of the awards that Singapore Airlines had won. Goh Choon Phong, the head of Singapore Airlines, thanked the airline's customers. "We are grateful to our customers for their trust and support," he said.

Other airlines from Southeast Asia also did well. For example, Malaysia Airlines won an award for the best airline staff service in Asia. And AirAsia was named the world's best low-cost airline again. It has won this award every year since 2010.
